product_question: What operational context can be joined to Category 9 without claiming an incident-level outcome or causal driver?

descriptive_screen.unit: Pearson correlation across five named boroughs by twelve months
descriptive_screen.use_rule: Hypothesis prioritization only; no driver, causal, outcome, adequacy, or candidate interpretation.

taxlane_assessment.reason: Borough-month alignment supports a bounded ecological screen. Different qualifying sets, no shared incident key, no patient outcome, and uncontrolled geography/time confounding block driver, causal, adequacy, intervention, and fiscal claims.

next_evidence.operations: Acquire ALS-unit-level call processing, staffing, fleet, posting, routing, and hospital-interface measures tied to the Category 9 qualifying set.
next_evidence.outcomes: Acquire privacy-safe patient outcomes with a compatible incident or cohort identity.
next_evidence.design: Pre-specify a multivariable or quasi-experimental design before testing any intervention effect.
next_evidence.candidate: Bound costs, delivery, incidence, and do-no-harm only after an effect is identified.

deferred_claims: candidate effect, delivery, cost, and savings
HLT reopening, allocation, and rate change

public_warning: Sixty named-borough/month observations support a reproducible ecological screen. Strong co-movement with dispatch timing and held share does not identify a driver: Category 9 and dispatch event definitions differ, no incidents or patient outcomes are linked, and borough/month confounding is uncontrolled. HLT, the $813.727B target, and both schedules remain unchanged.
